name: Flight Information
notes: Label 360 appears multiple times in document as segmented payload frames for flight information. Segment 1: constant/pad pattern with SSM=01. Segment 2: Flight Number Char #1 bits 9-11, Char #2 bits 16-22, Char #3 bits 23-29, SSM=00. Segment 3: Flight Number Char #4 bits 9-11, Char #5 bits 16-22, Char #6 bits 23-29, SSM=00. Segment 4: Flight Number Char #7 bits 9-11, Char #8 bits 16-22, Origin Char #1 bits 23-29, SSM=00. Segment 5: Origin Char #2 bits 9-11, Origin Char #3 bits 16-22, Origin Char #4 bits 23-29, SSM=00. Segment 6: Destination Char #1 bits 9-11, Destination Char #2 bits 16-22, Destination Char #3 bits 23-29, SSM=00. Segment 7: Destination Char #4 bits 9-11, bits 16-29 pad set to 0, SSM=00.
